priorStatus.title: §325-19E drafts demoted in R-3a only; R-3b's identical drafts from the same law piece still pass
priorStatus.reasoning: records/demoted.yaml now lists all five R-3b.325_19e_* limits: min_lot_area_other_use, max_height, max_coverage, side_yard_larger and side_yard_smaller. Each cites the R-3a key and the shared 'directly abuts' question. The rebuilt drafted/R-3b.yaml has all five as kind: flag, with no check or examples. The sixth piece, *_rear_yard, was already a flag in both districts. The drafting log's 325-19E unit has 12 rules, and every one is now a flag. The proposed measures only the R-3b checks used are gone from proposed_measures.yaml (abutting_r1_height_limit, larger_side_yard_abuts_r1, smaller_side_yard_abuts_r1). The new test test_a_demotion_whose_cause_is_the_law_holds_in_every_district_the_law_piece_covers walks every cause that names a section. It looks up the drafting unit that owns the rule and asserts the same suffix is a flag in every district that unit drafted. It also asserts that an abutting R-3b lot gives needs_review for coverage. The test passes. The replay tests (test_eval_replay) pass and the grade tests (test_eval) pass.

priorStatus.title: `approved` now lets a relaxer widen a rule, but the approval hash leaves out `relaxes`
priorStatus.reasoning: rulebook.py:43-44 adds 'relaxes' to APPROVED_FIELDS. approval_hash builds its fingerprint as {k: entry.get(k) for k in fields}, so adding, removing or retargeting relaxes changes the hash. Adding the field does change the hash of every existing approved rule (a missing field now counts as relaxes: None). But no YAML in the repo carries approved_hash, so nothing that exists breaks. The test fixtures compute their hashes at runtime. The new test test_an_approval_covers_which_rule_the_approved_rule_widens covers both cases: a link added after approval, and a link retargeted after signing. Both report 'changed since it was approved'. The test passes.

priorStatus.title: demote() keeps `relaxes`, so a demoted relaxer crashes apply_relaxes (KeyError 'check') and fails validation
priorStatus.reasoning: Both suggested parts are in. demote() (__main__.py:155) now drops 'relaxes' as well as check, review_when, examples and notes. apply_relaxes (rulebook.py:113-114) now counts a rule as a relaxer only if relaxes is text, kind == 'rule', and check and applies_when are both set. A flag or a rule with no check can no longer reach x['check'] or x['applies_when'] at lines 126-135. A relaxer it skips leaves the base unchanged, which can only be stricter, so this never gives a false pass. _relaxes_problems still reports such a relaxer, so it never fails silently. Tests: test_drafting.py::test_a_demoted_relaxer_widens_nothing_and_its_rulebook_stays_valid and test_relaxes.py::test_a_relaxer_with_no_check_widens_nothing_and_never_crashes both pass. A related case remains: a demoted base rule with a still-live relaxer pointing at it. Validation reports that loudly ('has no check to widen'), it can't give a pass, and no drafted rulebook has a relaxes link today, so I am not reporting it as a finding.
